headline: How Investors Are Reacting To Charles Schwab (SCHW) Dividend And Surge In Retail Bullish Sentiment
summary: Charles Schwab recently declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of US$0.32 per common share, alongside several preferred stock dividends payable in August and September 2026 to shareholders of record in mid-August. The company also released its Q3 2026 Retail Client Sentiment Report showing a sharp rise in bullish views and a strong willingness among active traders to buy market dips, underlining Schwab’s central role in shaping retail investor behavior.
